_comment: Configurable escalation handoff (NOT hard-coded in the skill). Edit freely. Assignee values are opaque to this skill — a user id, handle or email that the configured issue_tracker adapter understands. No tenant values belong here: project key, key pattern and the tracker itself come from .claude/loops/stack.config.json.

assignees._comment: default: who gets an escalation when the area has no entry (null = leave unassigned and say so). by_area: keys are the area names dev-intake writes into intake.json (e.g. 'billing', 'invoices', 'members'); values are tracker user ids/handles or null.

_transition_note: transition_on_escalate: the tracker status name the ticket moves to on escalation (e.g. 'To Do' or 'Needs Human'), or null to leave the status alone. Interpreted by the issue_tracker adapter.
_notification_note: notification_channel: the channel the notifications adapter posts the handoff summary to (always, when posting is authorized). With the default 'file' provider that is runs/notifications/<channel>.md.
